verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents API/CLI (firectl) access to essentially every major capability — inference, fine-tuning, LoRA deployment, model upload, autoscaling, batch inference, benchmarking — implying an API-first architecture where the UI is largely a thin layer over these APIs. However, there is no explicit statement or audit confirming full UI/API feature parity, and no evidence addressing whether any UI-only conveniences (e.g., dashboard analytics, billing, team management) lack API equivalents. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or audit, evidence covering account/billing/UI-only features, and independent confirmation that no UI feature is API-inaccessible.
